input.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
input.rationale: The only ownership provision (§2(d)) confirms TrueLink's rights in the Interface; nothing in the Agreement confirms that we own Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property, our borrower/loan data or the results of the Support Services (deliverables), which TrueLink's programmer creates for us. Section 10 only treats those items as Client Proprietary Information for confidentiality purposes, which is not an ownership right, and §8(d) grants TrueLink a broad licence (use, resell, exploit) over Credit Data without any statement that we retain title. This is a critical gap under the IP rule, so we insert a reciprocal Client ownership clause with assignment of deliverables, a licence back for embedded TrueLink IP, and no joint ownership. We left the negotiated §8(d) Credit Data licence (already narrowed by the Credit Data definition and the Non-Competition Agreement) intact, clarifying only that it is a licence and not a transfer of ownership.

proposal.summary: Add a Client ownership provision covering Client Content, Client Intellectual Property, Client data and Support Services deliverables, with a licence back for embedded TrueLink IP.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement confirms TrueLink's ownership of the Interface but says nothing about what we own, so we have added a reciprocal provision: we retain all right, title and interest in Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and our borrower, loan and other data, and we own the results of the Support Services with a licence back to TrueLink's pre-existing IP embedded in them. Our position is that we own what we pay for and everything we put in, with no joint ownership; if TrueLink prefers, we can instead take a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense those results for our business.

ops.text: e. Client Ownership. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property, the Web Site and all data provided by or on behalf of Client or its customers or borrowers (including borrower and loan data), and TrueLink acquires no ownership right therein, the license granted in Section 8(d) being a limited, nonexclusive license only. All results of the Support Services and any other deliverables, work product, customizations or materials created by TrueLink for Client under this Agreement shall be owned exclusively by Client, and TrueLink hereby assigns all right, title and interest therein to Client; provided that TrueLink retains ownership of TrueLink's Intellectual Property existing prior to or developed independently of such work, and grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense any TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded in such results or deliverables for Client's business purposes. No item of intellectual property shall be jointly owned by the parties.
